notes: INSIDE half of the Heat Lance (neon): twelve heat fins in two banks that glow orange fin by fin as it charges (frame 5 = all twelve white-hot at the tips, strip yellow), a heat-core window, power coupling, hatch. fire: every fin flashes white. damaged: fins bent and dead, sparks; disabled: fins dark, a bank split. Barrel layer heat_lance_neon_barrel: the long beam-focus lens head with heat fins; fire: the lens flares white-orange and a beam starts.
